fact_text: DH Partners declared a dividend of PKR 1 per unit, which came in below the analyst's expectations.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 27 August 2025 | DHPL Dividend | ENGROH Infra Expansion| Pharma & Banks in Focus' (YouTube, 2025-08-27)

fact_text: DH Partners' fund size was about PKR 19 billion at 30 June 2025, above the roughly PKR 17 billion the analyst had expected to see.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 27 August 2025 | DHPL Dividend | ENGROH Infra Expansion| Pharma & Banks in Focus' (YouTube, 2025-08-27)

fact_text: The analyst expects DH Partners' payouts and fund size to grow gradually over later quarters and years, and he advised investors not to panic over the modest payout.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 27 August 2025 | DHPL Dividend | ENGROH Infra Expansion| Pharma & Banks in Focus' (YouTube, 2025-08-27)

fact_text: Dolmen City REIT's payout reached 63 paisa in one quarter, after earlier quarters paid a small steady amount and some quarters paid nothing, as operations grew.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 27 August 2025 | DHPL Dividend | ENGROH Infra Expansion| Pharma & Banks in Focus' (YouTube, 2025-08-27)

fact_text: Fertilizer companies usually hold low inventories in the September quarter before wheat offtake rises in October and November, so the analyst saw that quarter as favourable for fertilizer payouts.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 27 August 2025 | DHPL Dividend | ENGROH Infra Expansion| Pharma & Banks in Focus' (YouTube, 2025-08-27)

fact_text: Engro Holdings has been steadily taking over telecom tower portfolios, including from Zong, and the analyst estimated about 14,000 towers to date.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 27 August 2025 | DHPL Dividend | ENGROH Infra Expansion| Pharma & Banks in Focus' (YouTube, 2025-08-27)

fact_text: The analyst said the tower business targets 25,000 towers, a target he heard about three to four years earlier, and that it is becoming a sizeable entity in telecom towers.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 27 August 2025 | DHPL Dividend | ENGROH Infra Expansion| Pharma & Banks in Focus' (YouTube, 2025-08-27)

fact_text: The analyst expected Engro Holdings' 2025 results to be less strong, with most visible earnings coming through Engro Fertilizer, while Engro Polymer is under gas-price pressure.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 27 August 2025 | DHPL Dividend | ENGROH Infra Expansion| Pharma & Banks in Focus' (YouTube, 2025-08-27)

fact_text: The analyst said Engro Holdings could in future bring its tower business to the market, which would be a possible option for investors.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 27 August 2025 | DHPL Dividend | ENGROH Infra Expansion| Pharma & Banks in Focus' (YouTube, 2025-08-27)

fact_text: The analyst said Engro Holdings may post a small profit in the second quarter of 2025, with dividend benefits more visible in later years.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 27 August 2025 | DHPL Dividend | ENGROH Infra Expansion| Pharma & Banks in Focus' (YouTube, 2025-08-27)

fact_text: The analyst described the bank growth chain: branch expansion lifts deposits, which fund advances through the credit creation model, and the same model works in Islamic banks.

fact_text: Islamic banks invest mainly in sukuk, such as government and K-Electric issues, rather than the PIBs and treasury instruments used by conventional banks.
